reason: I have run our firm on spreadsheets and WhatsApp groups for ten years, and switching my staff to new software is not worth the disruption when WhatsApp integration isn't even live yet. On top of that, keeping everything in Google Drive makes me nervous that a careless assistant will accidentally delete or move critical client folders.
objection: If files stay in our Google Drive, what happens if an assistant accidentally deletes or moves the folder?
would_change_my_mind: Foolproof delete and move protection on Google Drive folders so assistants cannot tamper with them, along with native WhatsApp integration so we don't have to change our ten-year routine.
